reports.standfirst: Arsenal came from behind to beat Leeds United 2-1, ending the visitors' unbeaten start.
reports.account: Riccardo Calafiori brought Arsenal level after 62 minutes, meeting Ben White's header with his left foot and sending the ball high into the middle of the goal. James Justin had put Leeds United in front after 55 minutes, turning Gabriel Gudmundsson's cross into the top corner. Bruno Guimarães, on for Myles Lewis-Skelly, won it 20 minutes from time, striking Declan Rice's pass low from outside the box into the corner.

sections.head: Justin's top-corner strike
sections.pitch: James Justin had three shots in the match, and the one from Gabriel Gudmundsson's cross gave Leeds United the only lead they held.
sections.stake: A free agent since Cowthenbeef let him go on Friday; seven points.

sections.head: Guimarães and Rice combine
sections.pitch: Bruno Guimarães now has two league goals this season, this one as a substitute. Declan Rice set it up and earned a defensive point besides.
sections.stake: Guimarães's six points are on the bench for Cowthenbeef; The Truffle Pigs has Rice, for six points.

sections.head: Calafiori, White link up
sections.pitch: Riccardo Calafiori's goal cancelled out Justin's, and it came from Ben White's header, his one assist of the match and the move that set Arsenal on the way back.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has Calafiori, for eight points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has White, for five points, and trails AtleticoTimHortons 43-27; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has four men to play, AtleticoTimHortons four.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Calafiori 8 (AtleticoTimHortons), Justin 7, Rice 6 (The Truffle Pigs), Guimarães 6 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: Brentford remain unbeaten in six after a 2-2 draw at Aston Villa.
reports.account:
John McGinn put Aston Villa 2-1 up with 13 minutes left, sweeping Johan Manzambi's pass into the bottom corner from inside the box. Brentford answered two minutes after McGinn's goal through Kristoffer Ajer, who converted Jaidon Anthony's pass with a low shot.
Yehor Yarmoliuk opened the scoring for the Bees after 10 minutes, his shot going into the middle of the goal. Nicolas Jackson replied for Villa after 12 minutes, finding one corner with a firm drive. Matteo Ruggeri went off injured at the interval. Kevin Schade left the Brentford side injured after 52 minutes.

sections.head: Jackson and Manzambi busy
sections.pitch: Nicolas Jackson took his league total to two with one of his four shots. Johan Manzambi had seven, created three chances, set up McGinn's goal and had chances good enough to score himself.
sections.stake: Jackson's six points are on the bench for The Truffle Pigs, more than the two it trails Cowthenbeef by; Cowthenbeef has Manzambi, for five points.

sections.head: Yarmoliuk's early opener
sections.pitch: Yehor Yarmoliuk's goal was the earliest of the four in this match, and the lead it gave Brentford lasted until Nicolas Jackson's reply.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: McGinn 7 (its_ohi), Yarmoliuk 7, Jackson 6 (The Truffle Pigs), Ajer 6

reports.standfirst: Chelsea beat AFC Bournemouth 5-1, leaving the Cherries still without a win this season.
reports.account:
Jordan Henderson struck after two minutes with a low shot from distance into the corner, Cole Palmer supplying the pass. Morgan Rogers sent the ball high into one corner one minute after Henderson's goal, the pass coming from Henderson himself.
João Pedro made it 3-0 just after half-time, sending Pedro Neto's pass up into the corner. Evanilson pulled one back for AFC Bournemouth from a corner after 51 minutes, his close-range effort going high through the middle. A fourth followed midway through the second half, João Pedro meeting Pep Chavarría's cross and finding the top corner. Henderson completed the 5-1 after 70 minutes with a shot into the angle.

sections.head: Henderson in three goals
sections.pitch: Jordan Henderson had three shots, two of which went in, and his pass for Rogers gave him a hand in three of Chelsea's five.

sections.head: João Pedro reaches five
sections.pitch: João Pedro's pair takes him to five league goals in the campaign, one from Pedro Neto's pass and the other from Pep Chavarría's cross.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef has him, for 10 points, and leads The Truffle Pigs 46-44; Cowthenbeef has three men to play, The Truffle Pigs three.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Henderson 16, João Pedro 10 (Cowthenbeef), Rogers 9 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Palmer 9 (The Raccoons)

keyStats.label: Chances created
keyStats.value: Henderson 2 (1 assist), Palmer 2 (1 assist), Truffert 2, Gannon-Doak 2

reports.standfirst: Ipswich Town beat Fulham 2-1 with two late goals.
reports.account: Abdoul Ouattara struck for Ipswich Town with two minutes left to make it 1-1, his shot from beyond the area finding the bottom corner. Ryan Sessegnon headed Kenny Tete's cross off target from inside the six-yard box after 24 minutes. He gave Fulham the lead after 55 minutes from a corner, shooting from outside the area. Dara O'Shea completed the turnaround in stoppage time with a low header from close range, substitute Jack Clarke, on for Jaden Philogene, delivering the set-piece cross.

sections.head: Ouattara's long-range leveller
sections.pitch: Abdoul Ouattara's goal ended Fulham's clean sheet with two minutes remaining and brought Ipswich Town back from behind, the winner arriving three minutes later.

sections.head: O'Shea's set-piece header
sections.pitch: Dara O'Shea's goal was the last of the match and turned a draw into a victory for Ipswich Town against a Fulham side who had led into the closing minutes.

sections.head: Sessegnon's goal not enough
sections.pitch: Ryan Sessegnon managed three shots, and the one that went in handed Fulham a lead they held for more than half an hour.
sections.stake: A free agent, seven points; his first league start this season.

reports.standfirst: Brighton & Hove Albion beat Sunderland 2-0 despite Pascal Struijk's red card.
reports.account: Pascal Struijk was sent off after 57 minutes with Brighton & Hove Albion a goal up, yet his side still added a second. Thomas Meunier had gone off injured for Sunderland after 34 minutes. Maxim De Cuyper put Brighton in front after 53 minutes, converting Pascal Groß's pass. Jaouen Hadjam, on for Diego Gómez, doubled the lead in stoppage time on the break from a through ball by fellow substitute Georginio Rutter, on for Yasin Ayari.

sections.head: Hadjam's late second
sections.pitch: Jaouen Hadjam had been on the pitch for a matter of minutes when his goal arrived, the second for a Brighton side playing with ten men.

sections.head: De Cuyper
sections.pitch: Maxim De Cuyper's goal was his second of the league season, set up by Pascal Groß, and he earned a defensive point alongside it.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has him, for nine points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: De Cuyper 9 (AtleticoTimHortons), Verbruggen 7 (Cowthenbeef), Vuskovic 7 (The Truffle Pigs), Kadioglu 7 (The Truffle Pigs)

reports.standfirst: Ten-man Tottenham Hotspur drew 1-1 with Manchester United through a late equaliser.
reports.account: Rodrigo Bentancur's dismissal five minutes after Bryan Mbeumo's goal left Tottenham Hotspur a man down and a goal behind. Mbeumo had put Manchester United ahead after 73 minutes, taking Matheus Cunha's pass inside the box and steering a finish from his sinister foot down into the corner. Dominic Solanke levelled two minutes into stoppage time, meeting Sandro Tonali's cross inside the box and heading down into the corner.

sections.head: Solanke's late header
sections.pitch: Dominic Solanke had four shots in the match, and his equaliser was the only one of them that went in.

sections.head: Cunha's assist
sections.pitch: Matheus Cunha's pass made the only goal Manchester United scored, an opener that kept them ahead of Tottenham until stoppage time.
sections.stake: its_ohi has him, for seven points, and leads If anyone can, Bannan can 40-34; its_ohi has four men to play, If anyone can, Bannan can three.
